result.instructions: Analyze Android DEX/APK using read-only SQL, paged smali and APK Manifest/resources. Use resources/list for the complete English documentation catalog, including unlinked pages. Read relevant pages using the URIs returned by the catalog. Inspect the schema, open_dataset, then query/decode or resource tools. Reuse dataset_id and close unused datasets. Follow next_offset; query paging re-executes SQL and needs stable ORDER BY. Classes default to method summaries. Running timeout/cancellation closes that dataset; reopen it to continue. list_datasets reports quotas. int64/uint64 cells are exact decimal strings.
